The presidents Keepers

By: Joy Summers | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
An explosive new book by veteran journalist blows the lid on those keeping President Zuma in power and out of prison

Unique Selling Point:
we have one of the key characters Adriana Mazzotti in an interview already and he may yet agree to another.

Summary:
While journalists have been uncovering massive corruption by the Gupta family and Zuma cronies, Pauw digs deep into the world of gangsters, cigarette smugglers, corrupt policemen and the host of characters that surround the president. The book explores the shadow mafia state. He reveals how the Gupta's tried to bribe former top cop Johan Booysen, how cigarette smugglers may be funding Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma's campaign, and how the president failed to pay his taxes year after year. Its a trail of lies and spies, cronies, cash and kingmakers as Pauw prises open the web of deciet that surrounds the president

Script:


President’s Keepers FINAL SCRIPT 11 06

Commentary One
In late 2015 Carte Blanche interviewed Adriano Mazotti, a flamboyant cigarette manufacturer, who claimed his company, Carnilinx had unfairly been a target of State security agents, big tobacco and SARS

Mazzotti
we are being harassed by big tobacco, their private security companies – tracking devices and they work with certain people in government institutions and they have undue influence on these institutions

Commentary Two
But in the world of Mazzotti, not everything is as it seems. About a year before we met him, Mazzotti apparently owed SARS R600 million rand, and the tough commissioner at SARS, Ivan Pillay, and head of high risk investigations, Johann Van Loggerenburg wanted him to pay up.

Devi
Are you dodgy?
Mazzotti
Definitely not

Commentary Three
To come clean with SARS, Mazzotti signed this affidavit admitting fraud, smuggling and attempted bribery.

Devi: Do you play by the rules
Mazzotti: Definitely, we play by the rules

Commentary Four
Then two weeks ago, veteran journalist Jacques Pauw exposed Mazotti in the Sunday Times. Pauw alleged Mazotti was assisting Presidential hopeful Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma with her campaign. She is seen in several photo’s with Mazotti, but has denied receiving financial aid from him.

Jacques Pauw
Most analysts agree the Gupta’s will leave soon, it’s becoming far too hot for them, so there are new jackals circling the carcass. Mr. Mazotti plays a central role in my book.

Commentary Five
Pauw’s new book, the President’s Keepers, has been causing waves since its release two weeks ago.

Jacques Pauw
As I finished the book I got information that he has had meetings with Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma and he is very eager to assist her in her presidential campaign. He has provided her
with election paraphernalia, he has met her several times, he has introduced other cronies to her- and he is a self- confessed criminal!

Commentary Six
Mazzotti rejects Pauw’s claims and may take legal action. In a recent call to Carte Blanche, Mazzotti admits signing the affidavit but says it’s been mischaracterized by Pauw. He does not want to comment on the claims about Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma

LINK
But Adriano Mazzotti is just one of an array of characters in Pauw’s book- as the author explores what he calls the shadow mafia state

Jacques
The central theme of the book is how JZ has destroyed the law enforcement agencies
Devi
So, which departments are you saying are compromised?
Jacques
I concentrate on SARS, the Hawks, Crime intelligence, the NPA and State security. In each and every department, there are JZ cronies that protect him, his friends and his family.

Commentary Seven
Under the stewardship of Ivan Pillay and Pravin Gordhan, SARS had become a world class revenue service. They cranked up the heat on gangsters, smugglers and the underworld and inevitably the SARS trail soon led to some of the president’s less savory benefactors

LINK
What Pauw discovered next shocked even him to the core. Our president was on the payroll of a private company owned by one of his friends, Roy Moodley.

Devi
You claim in the book that Roy Moodley paid the president a salary of million rand?
Jacques
Yes for 16 months for a year before he became president and four months into his presidency

Commentary eight
Moodley owns Royal security and that’s where an investigator found the president on the payroll, taking home R16 million rand says Pauw. Moodley has not replied to our questions

Devi
It’s a lot of money for doing security work.
Jacques
The highest paid security guard in the history of this country but we must also remember that JZ has a history of being a kept man.

LINK: Another central theme of the book is the destruction of SARS, and why the President had every reason to fear them
Commentary nine
Pauw tells how Pillay met the president in 2014 to coax him to pay his tax.
Jacques
Where Pillay said to him he has to understand they won’t treat him differently from any other taxpayer or it may result in an audit against him.

Commentary ten
Pauw writes that the taxable fringe benefits on Nkandla amounted to around R145 million rand, taxed at a rate of 40% worked out at R58 million rand but because he hadn’t declared it, the president was liable for a penalty of 10%. All in his taxes for Nkandla alone amounted to just over R63 million rand.

Jacques
Zuma couldn’t pay the R63 million and that could ultimately have led to his sequestration, and the president cannot be an insolvent, so what IP was saying to Zuma in Feb 2014 was very dangerous to the president

Commentary eleven
But there was a last and final solution for Zuma, the ultimate way out of his problems, says Pauw. Suddenly sinister and false accusations of the SARS rogue unit surfaced. The names of the very investigators that were ensuring the president and a host of rogues were tax compliant, were publicly smeared. Then Ivan Pillay was replaced by a compliant commissioner, Tom Moyane

Jacques
And what is significant is that the meeting between Pillay and Zuma took place in 2014 and less than a year later the top exec of SARS was gone.

Commentary thirteen
The journey of this book, is in itself a story. Pauw wrote it in secret anticipating exactly the kind of response he is getting. SARS say they are deeply concerned that he has revealed private tax information- in breach of the tax administration act.

We have asked for rights of reply from many of those mentioned in the book and without fail they have trashed it as inaccurate and untrue. The President himself has scoffed at it and called it a novel. As controversy grew so did the sales

LINK
Then a few days later, a second book, this time written by the former minister of intelligence Ronnie Kasrils, who paints a rather unflattering picture of President Jacob Zuma

Commentary fourteen
He called the book, A simple Man, because he says that is how JZ likes to project himself to the people

Devi
Is he a simple man of the people?

Ronnie
Absolutely not, he is devious, he has had a checkered career, he has guile and cunning.

Commentary sixteen
Ronnie Kasrils joined the ANC after the Sharpeville massacre and later served as commander of MK’s Natal regional command. In 1994, he became deputy minister of defence, later minister of water affairs and in 2004, minister of intelligence services under President Thabo Mbeki. And his friendship with Zuma goes back to 1980

Ronnie Kasrils
There were other comrades in Maputo who saw how engaging our friendship was, Zuma and mine who began to warn me to say be careful because he is sly.

Commentary Seventeen
Then another warning from two struggle icons.

Ronnie Kasrils
Joe Slovo and Joe Modise tell me they had to dissolve a structure which he lead, smuggling weapons into South Africa, and they were the commanders, because he was concealing various secrets from them, he had his own special group inner within the structure, and he was hiding this from non- Zulus in that structure

Commentary eighteen
By 2005 Kasrils himself, warned the ANC about Jacob Zuma at Party Headquarters

Ronnie Kasrils
I am talking to the SG of the communist party at the end of this long day in which we are debating Jacob Zuma so I continue and end in the following way

Reads:
You think you can manage him comrade Blade I replied. You will discover he is a law unto himself ….and I should have had the insight to add and the country as well.

Commentary nineteen
On Wednesday evening both Kasrils and Pauw’s books were officially launched. Midway through the launch of the Presidents Keepers in Hyde Park, the lights mysteriously went out.

On Thursday, a case was opened against Pauw, but the police have failed to say what the charges are. But revelations about a State Security Agency operation, the Principal Agent N, shut down in 2011 has prompted the agency to demand the book be withdrawn from the shelves.

LINK
The principal agent network was a highly secretive operation that Pauw describes as nothing but a coterie of thieving and squandering thugs. But here’s the kicker – the man who is now Director General of the State Security agency was part of it.
Commentary
This is Arthur Fraser – the Director general of the State Security Agency, and a man the Mail and Guardian reported who gave President Zuma the spy tapes. Pauw says Fraser controlled the agents of PAN

Jacques
AF installed a server at his house, and the investigators concluded that it looks like he was setting up a parallel intelligence network and they recommended charged with treason.
Devi
Why do you think the State Security Agency is now gunning you?
Jacques
Because its highly embarrassing for MR FRASER that all his dirty linen is now displayed in a book.

Commentary Twenty- three
Pauw’s allegations are serious. He says PAN agents lifted Ronnie Kasrils signature to give legitimacy to their off-book operations. The State security agency says they don’t want to comment because they are challenging the matter legally.

Ronnie Kasrils
I am so angry about this, I could ring Arthur Fraser neck!
Devi
Why should we be concerned about Arthur Fraser?
Jan
His position in this country is at the summit of intelligence and security, you need the most trustworthy, disciplined person of integrity and what is being revealed by Jacques which reflects what I know, and had seen, in terms of the spy tapes and my signature stolen, that is ample evidence of the kind of things that can go on, if protected by a president as people are saying, gone rogue

Twenty- Four
Kasrils stills holds out hope but sounds a warning at the end of his book.

Ronnie
Its right up to date the situation now with Zuma’s back to the wall. A cornered Zuma cries havoc and if he can get away with it would let slip the dogs of war – reasons, incidents and frame ups can be manufactured, if we allow the far from simple man and his cabal to win, then beware the apocalypse.

THE END 12 12

PROMO ONE
Two books, the Presidents Keepers, by Jacques Pauw, the other a Simple Man by former intelligence minister Ronnie Kasrils, lifts the lid on the President.

PROMO TWO
Ronnie Kasrils new book about President Zuma is called a Simple Man
Devi
Is he a simple man of the people?
Ronnie
Absolutely not, he is devious, he has had a checkered career, he has guile and cunning.


PROMO THREE
Investigative journalist Jacques Pauw’s new book has put him squarely in the sights of the STATE security agency
Devi
Why do you think the State Security Agency is now gunning you?
Jacques
Because its highly embarrassing for MR FRASER that all his dirty linen is now displayed in a book.
